remainingTestableDifferentiation: A narrower decision layer may remain only if James can show that exact-task deterministic post-result acceptance plus retry history and settlement-aware effective cost materially changes which payable endpoint an agent should buy versus the choices implied by public benchmark priors and pre-payment reliability/quote intelligence.
killGate: Once a comparable paid cohort exists, if James cannot demonstrate at least one reproducible provider-choice or retry-policy decision that differs because of its post-result acceptance/effective-cost evidence, treat the differentiation thesis as failed rather than broadening scope.
